scope: Original analysis records; no raw benchmark or hidden test data

records.depth_scope: Task-local artifact verifier flow, not full Harbor lifecycle
records.finding: The submitted evaluation pipeline is itself the evaluated artifact; separate checks assess extraction, grader behavior and result consistency. Executable artifacts are treated as untrusted code.
records.limitations: No environment build, model inference or security audit. README timing summary is stale relative to operational configuration.

records.finding: Registered mechanical constraints need not cover the whole natural-language request. Prompt-level AND and instruction-level mean are distinct metrics. Loose scoring chooses transformations independently for each constraint.
records.limitations: No model generation or full benchmark scoring.

records.depth_scope: Only an isolated source-function experiment on synthetic input
records.finding: Synthetic response passes loose prompt scoring while no single allowed transformed candidate satisfies every constraint.
records.limitations: This is the implemented upper-bound behavior, not automatically a defect. Frequency and effect on real model scores are unknown.

records.depth_scope: Overall depth held at D1 despite source tracing because complete real data row was not accessible in this pass
records.finding: Prompt truncation, two-stage CoT, literal answer extraction, skipped API failures and partial-result denominators are distinct operational conditions.
records.limitations: HF viewer reported oversized row groups and direct JSON read timed out; dataset revision unpinned; no model run or claim about published-score validity.
